item.title: A ‘brotherhood’ of Oakland and SF rappers drop epic collab album
item.description: A ‘brotherhood’ of Oakland and SF rappers drop epic collab album On "1 Umbrella," ALLBLACK, 22nd Jim, Lil Bean, ZayBang and Lil Yee deliver a raw, authentic collaboration about life in the Bay.

item.title: Oakland is struggling to field 911 dispatchers
item.description: Oakland is struggling to field 911 dispatchers OPD is relying on overtime to cover roughly one-third of its budgeted emergency call center jobs.

item.title: Olfactory Brewing shutters Berkeley taproom, and Montclair’s Highwire in limbo
item.description: Olfactory Brewing shutters Berkeley taproom, and Montclair’s Highwire in limbo A running list of restaurants that have recently closed in Berkeley, Oakland, Richmond, and beyond.

item.title: Culture Makers: Keeping Oakland’s literary scene strong
item.description: Culture Makers: Keeping Oakland’s literary scene strong Join The Oaklandside on March 19 for a lively discussion with local authors Jasmine Guillory and Carolina Ixta, and Nomadic Bookshop founder J.K. Fowler.

item.title: New Oakland speed cameras send 70K warnings in first month
item.description: New Oakland speed cameras send 70K warnings in first month The city added 18 speed cameras on January 14 as part of a mult-city statewide pilot. Fines start in mid-March.

item.title: Walking Bruce Lee’s Oakland with Jeff Chang
item.description: Walking Bruce Lee’s Oakland with Jeff Chang Chang, the hip hop historian and cultural critic, has written a vivid history of the martial arts legend and his worlds. He takes us on a tour of Lee’s days in Oakland.

item.title: Voters will decide on a new Oakland parcel tax in June
item.description: Voters will decide on a new Oakland parcel tax in June The City Council and unions are banking on voters approving the $34 million measure for police, fire, and other services.

item.title: ‘World famous’ fried chicken, a tiki bar, a sports bar, and a chocolate shop all among East Bay’s February closures
item.description: ‘World famous’ fried chicken, a tiki bar, a sports bar, and a chocolate shop all among East Bay’s February closures Gus's, The Barbary, The Athletic Club, and Xocolate's Rockridge shop were some of the food businesses to shutter recently.

item.title: Illegal dumpers could have vehicle registration blocked under proposed law
item.description: Illegal dumpers could have vehicle registration blocked under proposed law State Senator Jesse Arreguín’s bill aims to make it harder for people caught trashing Oakland’s streets to ignore fines.

item.title: Alameda County public defender challenges judge over lack of Black jurors
item.description: Alameda County public defender challenges judge over lack of Black jurors A misdemeanor case has surfaced a troubling pattern in Alameda County juries, which often fail to reflect the community’s diversity.
